name: rebirth-progression
description: Verify the scalable server-authoritative Rebirth economy, real HUD review-confirm input, exact reset/retain policy, training shutdown, respawn state, Honor headroom, compact layout, and clean lifecycle.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') local n='PunchWall Rebirth Flow Phone 740x360' local id for _,x in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do if S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(x).Name==n then id=x break end end local d={Name=n,Width=740,Height=360,PixelDensity=326,DeviceForm=Enum.DeviceForm.Phone} if id then S:UpdateDeviceAsync(id,d) else id=S:CreateDeviceAsync(d) end S:SetDeviceAsync(id) S:SetOrientationAsync(Enum.ScreenOrientation.LandscapeLeft) S:SetScalingModeAsync(Enum.DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.FitToWindow) task.wait(.4) local r=S:GetResolutionAsync() return H:JSONEncode({active=S:GetDeviceAsync()==id,width=r.X,height=r.Y})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local expected={{0,55,1000000,1.25},{4,55,1939000,2.25},{5,60,2288000,2.5},{9,60,4436000,3.5},{10,65,5234000,3.75},{24,75,53110000,7.25},{25,80,62669000,7.5},{49,99,3328269000,13.5},{50,99,3927357000,13.75},{100,99,19636785000,26.25},{249,99,66450879000,63.5}} local rows={} local ok=G.Rebirth.Version=='ScaledRebirthV1' and G.Rebirth.MaxRebirths==250 for _,e in ipairs(expected) do local q=G.RebirthRequirement(e[1]) local exact=q.currentRebirths==e[1] and q.nextRebirths==e[1]+1 and q.requiredLevel==e[2] and q.requiredCoins==e[3] and math.abs(q.permanentMultiplier-e[4])<.0001 and q.maxed==false and q.requiredCoins==math.floor(q.requiredCoins) and q.requiredCoins<9e15 ok=ok and exact rows[#rows+1]={r=e[1],level=q.requiredLevel,coins=q.requiredCoins,bonus=q.permanentMultiplier,exact=exact} end local cap=G.RebirthRequirement(250) ok=ok and cap.maxed==true and cap.nextRebirths==250 and G.RebirthBonus(1e99)==63.5 assert(ok,'Rebirth formula mismatch '..H:JSONEncode(rows)) return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok,rows=rows,cap=cap.maxed,maxBonus=G.RebirthBonus(250)})

steps.label: canonical scalable Rebirth checkpoints are exact and finite

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local b=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD.RebirthButton local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation local ok=b.Visible and b.Active and b.Selectable and math.min(b.AbsoluteSize.X,b.AbsoluteSize.Y)>=44 and a:Invoke('OpenRebirth','flow_locked')==true assert(ok,'standalone Rebirth route is unavailable') task.wait(.15) local w=g.RebirthWindow assert(w.Visible and g.GameMenu.Tabs.Visible==false,'legacy combined tabs are visible') return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok,hit=math.min(b.AbsoluteSize.X,b.AbsoluteSize.Y),window=w.Visible})

args.code: local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD assert(g.PunchWallClientAutomation:Invoke('OpenRebirth','flow_ready')==true,'standalone Rebirth route unavailable') task.wait(.15) local w=g.RebirthWindow local hint=w:FindFirstChild('ReadyHint',true) local reset=w:FindFirstChild('ContractValue',true) assert(w.Visible and w:GetAttribute('RebirthState')=='READY','ready standalone Rebirth state missing') assert(hint and hint.Text=='READY • REVIEW BEFORE RESET','ready hint is stale or misleading') assert(reset and string.find(reset.Text,'WALL LV 1',1,true) and string.find(reset.Text,'TRAINING STOPS',1,true),'reset contract is ambiguous') return true

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation local s=c:Invoke('Snapshot') local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local inv=H:JSONDecode(s.PetInventoryJSON) local pets=H:JSONDecode(s.EquippedPetsJSON) local owned=H:JSONDecode(s.OwnedFistsJSON) local premium=H:JSONDecode(s.OwnedPremiumFistsJSON) local ok=s.Rebirths==1 and s.Power==25 and s.Coins==0 and s.WallLevel==1 and s.WallXP==0 and s.FistMultiplier==1 and s.BreakSpeed==1 and s.EquippedFist=='Starter Glove' and s.TrainingActive==0 and s.TrainingStationId=='rookie_bag' and s.Depth==65 and s.Score==12345 and s.Honor==105 and s.HonorRebirthMilestoneMask==1 and s.FistMastery==44 and s.CritChance==17 and math.abs(s.Luck-9.03)<.001 and table.find(owned,'Boxing Glove')~=nil and table.find(premium,'Crimson Vanguard')~=nil and #inv==1 and #pets==1 and s.EquippedHonorItem=='Vanguard Trail' and math.abs(s.HonorPowerBonus-.02)<.001 and s.SettingsJSON:find('motion',1,true)~=nil and (p:GetAttribute('CoinBoostExpiresAt') or 0)>workspace:GetServerTimeNow() and (p:GetAttribute('DamageBoostExpiresAt') or 0)>workspace:GetServerTimeNow() assert(ok,'Rebirth reset/retain mismatch '..H:JSONEncode(s)) return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok,rebirths=s.Rebirths,power=s.Power,coins=s.Coins,level=s.WallLevel,depth=s.Depth,score=s.Score,honor=s.Honor,luck=s.Luck,training=s.TrainingActive,station=s.TrainingStationId,pets=#pets})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') local n='PunchWall Rebirth Flow Phone 740x360' S:StopSimulationAsync() local removed=0 for _,id in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do local info=S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(id) if info.Name==n and info.IsCustom then S:RemoveDeviceAsync(id) removed+=1 end end return H:JSONEncode({default=S:GetDeviceAsync()=='default',removed=removed})
